test_PackTag: test the PackTag function to encode a field number and wire type into a protobuf tag
test_UnpackTag: test the UnpackTag function to decode a protobuf tag into its field number and wire type
test_ZigZagEncode: test the ZigZagEncode function to encode signed integers for efficient varint serialization
test_ZigZagDecode: test the ZigZagDecode function to decode zigzag-encoded integers back to signed values
test_ByteSizeFunctions: test all numeric ByteSize functions to calculate wire format byte sizes for protobuf fields
